name: Progression de tournoi
description:
These tournament grounds in Port Ormos have been reserved for the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. You can view match progress and access the main arena via a secret passage near the match noticeboard to duke it out with your next opponent.
It is said that upon hearing that this location attracts the largest crowds, the organizers of the Nilotpala Cup put much effort into developing an abandoned Domain nearby and renovating it into the main tournament arena...
